newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch blue chips head higher, helped by KPN.
newsitem.headline: Dutch blue chips head higher, helped by KPN.

text.p: 0825 GMT - Dutch blue chips swing into positive territory, helped by strong demand for Dutch PTT after initial dip on Philips profit-taking. Dealers say Friday's options expiry cannot brake index uptrend which could head for new intra-day high.
* AEX up 4.27 points (0.50 percent) at 853.40 at 0823 GMT.
* Dutch PTT tops volume charts, adds 3.90 guilders to 83.30
* Philips narrows early losses, down one
